system.description:
Many Elves delight in the simple and straight-forward art of cutting and polishing gems. Their experience, dedication and patience in the art shows in the quality of their work. Any gem stone cut by an Elf adds +1D of Resources value compared to what it would normally be. In addition, this skill shares the same flexibility with Antiphon Union as Smithcraft.

Obstacles: Jade, Ob 1. Emerald, Ob 2. Ruby and sapphire, Ob 3. Opal and pearls, Ob 4. Diamond, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Jewelcraft, Smithcraft

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Workshop.

Restrictions: Elves only

Root: Will/Agility (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 275
